findings.detail: The Go model set is reasoning-heavy. Generation needed 16384 tokens and a 180s deadline to receive an artifact; 4096 tokens and 60s were consumed by reasoning. The MOTD budget (256 tokens) is consumed by reasoning_content before any content is emitted, so the service falls back.

Some models (observed: minimax-m3) emit their chain of thought inside the content channel with a model-specific marker instead of using reasoning_content. The generation parser tolerates this by locating the JSON artifact, but the MOTD sanitizer does not separate reasoning from the welcome.

Generated JavaScript is not guaranteed to pass staging validation. An earlier prompt under-specified the result shape, so the model invented an invalid view mode; the hardened prompt (explicit view.mode "text" and the exact result object) passed validation in the latest live run. The configuration carries max_repairs but the composed engine still does not implement a repair loop.

limits: one provider (OpenCode Go) and the chat protocol were exercised live; other protocol families were not re-run here
the Zen free tier rejects non-OpenCode clients, so free Zen models are not usable from this integration

no single tested model both answered the MOTD within its 20s/256-token budget and produced a generation artifact; deepseek-v4.1-flash generated, mimo-v2.6-flash answered the MOTD, and minimax-m3 did both but with reasoning in content
